m1-d2-symbol-identity.title: D2: a nested definition's symbol carries its enclosing METHOD
m1-d2-symbol-identity.imperative: Defect (a). scripts/code_map/extract.py builds a definition's symbol from clsstack[-1] whenever any class is on the stack, so a closure defined inside Class.method is emitted as mod:Class.<closure> and two same-named closures in two methods of one class merge into one symbol with a unioned caller set. Write the reproducer FIRST, naming the four measured collisions from .agent-work/issue-456/reference/d2_collisions.txt individually by string -- not by count -- plus a synthetic fixture for the class-defined-inside-a-function arm, which has zero occurrences on this corpus. Commit the reproducer FAILING. Then make each definition's symbol the enclosing scope's symbol plus its own name, so it equals supplement.py's qualified key, and keep every resolver that spells a class-qualified symbol (self.x, cls.x, the class-body name rule) spelling the same string. Attest c1 with the before/after symbol string for all four named collisions.

m3-page-identity.title: Page identity: two entity names differing only by case cannot land on one file

Write the reproducer FIRST over a SYNTHETIC module holding a fresh case-only pair with nothing to do with Verdict -- a fix that only resolves the pair you were shown cannot fail on the next pair -- and commit it FAILING. Then make case-only collisions impossible by construction in the renderer's page naming, deterministically (hashlib, never the builtin hash: PYTHONHASHSEED varies and deterministic-rebuild would catch it). Do NOT rename class Verdict or def verdict in scripts/run_skill_eval.py -- Commander ruling. Delete the strict-xfail marker at tests/test_code_map.py:982; strict forces this. Attest c1 with the RED output and exit code.

triage_candidates.statement: supplement.walk descends node.body only, so any definition inside a compound statement (with/if/try/for) gets no page at all. Measured: one of the four D2 collision members, at tests/test_context_manifest.py:771, sits inside a with block and is invisible to the supplement while extract.py (generic_visit) sees it. The two AST passes disagree about what the corpus contains, and entity_symbol_join cannot see it because it iterates supplement keys.

The INDEX page-filename family: an entity named INDEX still overwrites its own module's index page. Left unfixed on purpose -- _make_collision_repo is page_accounting's only cross-platform falsifier, and reserving the stem would make that g1 test unable to fail. Fixing it needs the falsifier rebuilt on a different collision first.

resolve_attr's self.x / cls.x branches still call class_member(clsstack[-1], attr), which walks build_table's MODULE-LEVEL class records, so for a class nested inside another class or inside a function that lookup can read a same-named module-level class's member set. Zero occurrences in this corpus (0 nested classes measured) and the fallback below it is now correct via clsyms, so this is latent, not live. The same len(clsstack)==1 gate applied to resolve_name R2a would close it.

why_trail.why: Successor attempt-2 cold-started from the plan: re-read g2-implement-2.md (successor handoff, incl. the two corrections and the g1-tripwire map), g2-implement-RESULT.md, g2-design-note.md, the original g2-implement.md and STATE_NOTE.md. Handoff complete on all eight fields. Baseline recorded by attempt-1: 1729 passed / 2 skipped / 1 xfailed, exit 0; suite is red by design right now because defect (a)'s reproducer is committed FAILING at 80702615. Resuming at m1-d2-symbol-identity.

Defect (a) fixed and committed at 6d5b3131. extract.py: one child_sym() rule (enclosing scope's symbol + name) replaces both clsstack[-1] expressions; a parallel clsyms stack makes self.x, cls.x and the class-body name rule spell the same string; the R2a member-set lookup is gated on a module-level class. Store symbol now equals supplement's qualified key by construction, so checks.entity_symbol_join was STRENGTHENED from a leaf comparison to a whole-symbol one, and the D2 docstrings in render.py and checks.py no longer assert a fixed defect. Reproducer green: 5 passed, 8 subtests passed. Full file: 42 passed, 1 xfailed (the defect-(c) marker, still expected).

Defect (b) fixed and committed at 103d03b5. render.refs_line appends '+ N in this module' when the page's own module holds counted sites, and every inbound line is followed by REFS_LEGEND naming what was counted (calls and reads that resolved to this symbol) and what was not. The trap was avoided: the caller list still holds the OTHER modules only, so OWN_MODULE_NAMED_MUTATION's byte-exact anchor 'ext = sorted(m for m in callers if m != mod)' survives and the input precondition of test_refs_lines_are_self_consistent_on_an_intact_map (some page counts a module it does not name) still holds. checks.py: REFS_MODULES gains an optional trailing group, Refs gains 'own', refs_line_self_consistent replaces 'at most one unnamed' with the exact rule in both directions plus own<=sites, sites-own>=len(named) and the legend-follows rule; no failure mode removed. inbound_attribution now also checks the own-module clause against the store. Two NEW mutation tests (own-clause dropped, legend dropped) both go red. tests/test_code_map.py: 47 passed, 1 xfailed.

Defect (c) fixed and committed at cdfd8213. render.assign_page_filenames assigns page filenames per module directory: names grouped by FOLDED spelling, only a group with more than one member disambiguated as <name>~<sha1[:8]>.md. hashlib not hash(). All three filename spellings (run's emit, entity_page's child list, module_index's walk) read the same assignment, so links move with files. The INDEX family is deliberately left colliding: _make_collision_repo is page_accounting's only cross-platform falsifier and reserving the stem would make it unable to fail; filed as triage. class Verdict / def verdict NOT renamed -- ruling stands, not falsified. Real corpus after a fresh build: 3761 pages, 0 case-only folds, exactly 2 disambiguated filenames. The strict-xfail XPASSed and the marker, COLLISION_XFAIL_REASON, the case-sensitivity probe and the now-unused pytest import are all DELETED. tests/test_code_map.py: 52 passed, 0 xfailed. python -m scripts.code_map check after a fresh build: exit 0, all 6 checks ok.
